# third_party

Nothing in this folder is committed except this note. See ../THIRD_PARTY.md for what is downloaded here and its licence status.

`scripts/fetch-reference-maps.sh` downloads reference map files here (DPjudge-format
`.map` files from the open-source Python `diplomacy` package, AGPL-3.0). They are used
only as local input for the rule tests and for trying out the importer. They are other
people's work under other licences, so Parley does not redistribute them.
